description: Figure 8(d) illustrates the performance on Qwen2.5, with co-occurrence number on the x-axis and ACC (%) on the y-axis. The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number”, is linear, ranges from 10<sup>1</sup> to 10<sup>3</sup>, and has tick labels at intervals of 10<sup>1</sup>, 10<sup>2</sup>, and 10<sup>3</sup>. The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)”, is linear, ranges from 60 to 80, and has tick labels at intervals of 5. There are six lines displayed: a green solid line representing “Base” which begins at approximately 68% and ends at approximately 74%; a purple dashed line representing “MEND” which begins at approximately 72% and ends at approximately 78%; a red dashed line representing “MEMIT” which begins at approximately 69% and ends at approximately 75%; an orange dotted line representing “FT” which begins at approximately 66% and ends at approximately 72%; a brown solid line representing “IKE” which begins at approximately 65% and ends at approximately 70%; and a blue dashed line representing “ROME” which begins at approximately 67% and ends at approximately 73%.
